articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers. Step-free access is available via alternative routes.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 8:36am on Friday, 14 August 2026, and will remain unavailable until further notice. This disruption affects passengers using the tram service in both directions.

For those travelling towards Manchester, step-free access can be obtained via a ramp from Cromford Street directly to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading towards Rochdale can also use a ramp from Cromford Street, but will need to cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption and is advising passengers to plan their journeys accordingly. Passengers are encouraged to check the latest travel alerts on the Transport for Greater Manchester website for more information and advice regarding alternative access routes.

Anyone directly affected may request a correction or right of reply by emailing news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.
